claim:
For \(t\ge 0\), let \(L_t\) be the closure of \((\sigma_1\sigma_3\sigma_2^4)^t\sigma_1\sigma_3\). Put \(\delta=-A^2-A^{-2}\), let \(F_t(A)=\langle L_t\rangle\) be the Kauffman bracket, and let \(E\) denote the forward shift in \(t\). Define
\[
Q_1(\lambda)=A^{12}\lambda-A^{10}\lambda^2-2A^8\lambda+2A^4\lambda+A^2-\lambda,
\]
\[
Q_2(\lambda)=A^{16}\lambda-A^{14}\lambda^2-A^{12}\lambda+2A^8\lambda-A^4\lambda-A^2+\lambda,
\]
and
\[
P_A(\lambda)=(A^2+\lambda)(A^6-\lambda)Q_1(\lambda)Q_2(\lambda).
\]
Then \(P_A(E)F_t=0\) for every \(t\ge0\). Since the braid is positive with writhe \(6t+2\), the normalized Jones sequence \(J_t(A)=V_{L_t}(A^{-4})=A^{-18t-6}F_t(A)\) satisfies \(P_A(A^{18}E)J_t=0\). The leading coefficient of \(P_A\) is the Laurent unit \(-A^{24}\), so this is an explicit sixth-order recurrence for every Jones polynomial in the family.
integrity: The recurrence is certified by an exact standard-library replay of the fourteen-dimensional Temperley--Lieb diagram algebra. The main literature risk is an unindexed prior specialization of a general braid-recurrence method to this exact repeated block.
scientific_limitations: The displayed degree-six annihilator is proved, but minimal recurrence order, dominant-root asymptotics, coefficient cancellation, and consequences for Khovanov-to-Jones cancellation are not claimed.
title: A sixth-order Jones recurrence for a Khovanov-large four-braid family
